'''2006 Iowa State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship announced for Saturday 24 June 2006 at Mayhem Collectibles, 2532 Lincoln Way, Ames, Iowa, run by [[Jason Huffman]], who had also run the 2005 event.<ref name="pcf-10188-138521">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=138521#138521 2006 Iowa State Championship - June 24th, Ames, IA], Jason Huffman (darklordhuff), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618081843/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=10188&view=previous Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-10188-137666">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=137666#137666 2006 Iowa State Championship - June 24th, Ames, IA], Jason Huffman (darklordhuff), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (18 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618081843/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=10188&view=previous Internet Archive]</ref> The winner was to design a [[Virtual cards|virtual card]] and receive a bye into Day 2 of the [[2006 World Championship|World Championship]].<ref name="pcf-10188-138521" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Mayhem Collectibles, 2532 Lincoln Way, Ames, Iowa<ref name="pcf-10188-138521" />
* '''Dates:''' 24 June 2006<ref name="pcf-10188-138521" />
* '''Schedule:''' registration 11:00–12:00; constructed tournament 12:00–6:00 pm; prize distribution 6:00–6:30 pm; final confrontation (#1 against #2) 6:30–8:30 pm<ref name="pcf-10188-138521" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, six games; decklists mandatory<ref name="pcf-10188-138521" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $6, with $1 off for completed decklists brought before the start<ref name="pcf-10188-138521" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Jason Huffman]]<ref name="pcf-10188-138521" />
* '''Prizes:''' a virtual card design and a Day 2 World Championship bye for the winner; six uncut sheets, boxes of cards, singles and tournament foils<ref name="pcf-10188-138521" />

== Organization ==

On 18 May 2006 Huffman wrote that he planned to run the tournament again with Mayhem Collectibles on 24 June, recalling the 2005 event's "great field with tons of prize support".<ref name="pcf-10188-137666" /> He posted the final details on 25 May, saying the format was basically the same as in 2005.<ref name="pcf-10188-138521" /> On 5 June [[Nick Kolnik]] answered a question in the topic: tournament directors could not compete in a championship circuit event they were running.<ref name="pcf-10188-139812">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=139812#139812 2006 Iowa State Championship - June 24th, Ames, IA], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (5 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618081843/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=10188&view=previous Internet Archive]</ref>

== Results ==

No results were posted in the forum topic as captured on 18 June 2006.
